results.summary: The council supports the fund purpose, adult Brent residency, savings rules, online application, Hub assistance and listed phone. Propose clarifying the application limit and partner rule. Awards remain discretionary; individual entitlement cannot be confirmed.

sources.note: Council describes essential-cost assistance, evidence requirements and a rolling limit assessed per couple.

findings.currentValue: Evidence required. Normally one application per rolling 12 months, even if a previous application was declined. Awards are discretionary.
findings.proposedValue: Evidence required. One application per rolling 12 months, even if declined. For couples, an application by either partner counts towards this limit; it does not apply to other adult household members. Awards are discretionary.
findings.reason: The council states a firm rolling application limit and explicitly applies it to couples; the listing omits the partner rule and says normally.
findings.evidence: One application is allowed in a rolling 12 months, approved or rejected. A partner application during that period is declined; other adults in the household are not included in this partner restriction.

results.summary: Provider voucher guidance supports emergency food for local people in financial hardship, requesting a voucher through Brent Hubs or an existing support agency, and Help through Hardship. Indexed guidance also says Job Centre vouchers have not been accepted since April 2026; the listing does not recommend that route. Current collection availability and centre times were not checked.

Indexed official guidance states Job Centre vouchers are no longer accepted from 1 April 2026. Existing listed enquiry routes remain supported.
